
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19849198" title="发布于 2026-04-11 00:06">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript如何实现中文脚本引擎</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<p class="ne-p">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行库，支持自定义语法解析，基于此，我们来实现一个中文脚本引擎示例。</p>
<p id="ucd6298eb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">示例实现一个条件语句：如果 ... 则 ... 否则 ...</span></p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u858122ee" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">1、实现ITokenHandler接口来自定义语法解析</span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 如果语法处理器 : ITokenHandler
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> HashSet&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; _StatementEndTokens = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HashSet&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">则</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">否则</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Build(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         e.IsHandled = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         e.End = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果前面有语句，则返回</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e.TreeBuilder.Root != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.TokenReader.Push(e.CurrentToken);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> condition =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, endTokens: _StatementEndTokens);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>         analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">则</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> createAllOptions = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BuildOptions(e.Options) { CreateFullTreeNode = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, createAllOptions, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, endTokens: _StatementEndTokens);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> node = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> IfNode { Condition = condition, Body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> body };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> nextToken =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.TokenReader.Read();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (nextToken.HasValue &amp;&amp; nextToken.Value.Value == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span>             nextToken =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.TokenReader.Read();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (nextToken.HasValue)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (nextToken.Value.Value == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">否则</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span>                 node.Else =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, createAllOptions, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                e.TokenReader.Push(nextToken.Value);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">37</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">38</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        e.TreeBuilder.Add(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options, e.Control, node);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">39</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">40</span> }</pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ubb2497df" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">2、继承ScriptLang，定义中文语言环境</span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 中文语言 : ScriptLang
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> 中文语言 实例 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 中文语言();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 中文语言()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         AddType&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">整型</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         AddType&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文本</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">如果</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 如果语法处理器());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">返回</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, AScript.TokenHandlers.ReturnTokenHandler.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> }</pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ub25bf977" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">3、注册中文语言</span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> Script.Langs[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">中文</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = 中文语言.实例;</pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u9345ddfe" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">4、中文脚本示例</span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">整型 n=10;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文本 s='';
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">如果 n&lt;5 则 {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    s='小于5';
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">} 否则 如果 n&lt;20 则 {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    s='大于等于5且小于20';
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">} 否则 {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    s='大于等于20';
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">返回 $'{n},{s}';
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">10,大于等于5且小于20</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ue84317d4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">中文脚本引擎为用户提供了自然语言的操作体验，特别适合领域专用语言、业务规则引擎等场景。感兴趣的同学赶紧在项目中用起来吧！</span></p>
